static_traits.name: Zhang Wei
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but has not discussed work-related fears with them; relationships with colleagues are affected by persistent anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, highly cooperative, good logic, able to accept new viewpoints, calm tone

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently fear being fired because I work only 40 hours per week.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this fear of losing my job has begun to affect my overall mental health and well-being.
growth_experiences: Two years ago, after starting work at a bank, the client began to fear being fired: the initial stress was moderate, but over time it developed into worrying about unemployment almost every day, especially more evident on weekends when not working; the client tried to relieve the fear by working overtime, but it was ineffective; the problem has affected work performance, interpersonal relationships, sleep, and eating.

A few years ago, the client met with repeated setbacks while learning to drive: during driving lessons the client found it difficult and formed the thought 'I am too stupid, I cannot understand traffic rules', and afterward avoided driving as much as possible; whenever thinking of or needing to drive, the client would feel strong anxiety and self-negation, making errands and independent travel inconvenient, and the client could only rely on family or public transportation; the family was supportive but did not fully understand the client's fear.

core_beliefs: I am clumsy, not smart enough, cannot do complex tasks well (such as driving)
My safety and worth depend on whether I overwork (more than 40 hours)

special_situations.event: On weekends when not working, thinking about working only 40 hours a week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not work at least 50 hours per week, I will be fired, showing I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proving oneself and trying to reduce risk through overtime, extending work hours
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be fired sooner or later; 40 hours is far from enough

special_situations.event: After finishing overtime, reviewing one's workload
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only constant overtime counts as safe; any effort below the self-set standard equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Discounting existing input and output, continuing to increase working hours
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These efforts do not count; I am still very insecure

special_situations.event: Needing to drive or merely thinking about driving
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot master the driving rules quickly and perfectly, it proves I am stupid and should not drive
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids driving, using family or public transport instead to reduce anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am so dumb; I will never learn to drive

special_situations.event: Realizing one works only about 40 hours per week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Less work time means greater risk, will bring serious consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly worrying, imagining the worst outcome to push oneself to work more
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If this continues, something serious will happen soon (being fired)

core_conflict.wish: Being recognized as competent and valuable; gaining stability and security
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, rejected, or fired
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of safety and avoiding being eliminated through excessive effort (overtime)
Avoids the experience of failure and shame by avoiding driving

object_relations.self_representation: An insecure employee who could be eliminated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh superior/employer who could fire someone at any time
Rules/roads and coaches that are hard to control and that judge oneself

manifestations: Avoids driving due to fear of driving, limiting autonomous travel and independence
Job security highly depends on the external standard of 'overtime', feeling bound by the rule
outcomes: Impaired life functioning (disturbed sleep and eating, inconvenient travel)
Interpersonal relationships are affected (interactions with colleagues are disrupted by anxiety)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: In counseling, repeatedly evaluates oneself with 'I am so stupid'
Setting harsh standards for driving and work performance, ignoring existing effort and achievements

positive_force: In self-evaluation, recognizing one's own qualities of being 'diligent, caring for others'
Family support; has a few close friends who can provide emotional support
Willing to try practicing gradually in small steps (open attitude toward change)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, fortune-telling, overgeneralization, and negating the positive maintain anxiety
Negative core self-evaluation ('I am stupid / incompetent')
Seeking a sense of safety through overtime and persistent worry, but instead worsening anxiety
Avoidance behavior toward driving maintains fear, limiting life autonomy
Chronic anxiety causes disturbed sleep and eating, impaired work and interpersonal functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and catastrophizing worry about being fired
antecedent: Thinking that one works only about 40 hours per week
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and fortune-telling cognitions (believing that if they do not work overtime they will be fired), accompanied by insecurity about ability and value
target_behavior.function: Trying to reduce uncertainty and avoid being fired through worrying and overtime
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance declined, relationships with colleagues affected, sleep and eating patterns disrupted, daily life impaired

antecedent: Thinking about driving or recalling the experience of failing to learn to drive
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core belief ('I am stupid / incompetent') and overgeneralization lead to fear of failure
target_behavior.function: Escaping anxiety and possible experiences of failure/shame
target_behavior.consequence: Losing some independence and convenience, needing to rely on family or public transport
